fields.finding: Multiplying a tube mass by reciprocal least SF is not a demonstrated structural restoration and cannot repair a separate film failure.
fields.proposed_fix: Recompute changed sections, Euler/local/Perry/global modes, film, fittings, sag and lift. Use the supplied corrected proportional masses only as sensitivities.
